## Background

Daily mortality and PM10 in London (2002–2006) often show a near-monotone
exposure–response: risk rises with pollution, with a base shape close to
$\sqrt{\mathrm{PM}_{10}}$. The near-monotone Gaussian process (mGP) of
[Zhang et al.](https://github.com/AgueroZZ/near_monotone_smoothing) places a
spline penalty on the departure from that base model (Ramsay, 1998), while
keeping $f(x_0)=f'(x_0)=0$ so case-crossover strata can absorb the intercept.

This vignette fits a time-stratified case-crossover model with
`mgp(pm10, a = 2)` and compares it to `iwp(pm10, p = 2)`.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  collapse = TRUE,
  comment = "#>",
  fig.width = 7,
  fig.height = 4.5
)
library(adlaplace)
library(adlaplaceFem)
if (file.exists("vignette_full.R")) {
  source("vignette_full.R", local = TRUE)
} else {
  vignette_full <- TRUE
  vignette_num_threads <- 2L
}
fit_num_shards <- if (vignette_full) 200L else 8L
fit_maxit <- if (vignette_full) 200L else 15L
```

## Data

```{r data}
data("london", package = "adlaplace")
london <- london[!is.na(london$pm10), ]
if (!vignette_full) {
  london <- london[london$year == 2003, ]
}
range(london$pm10)
range(london$tmean, na.rm = TRUE)
```

PM10 ranges from about 8.1 to 99.6 $\mu\mathrm{g}/\mathrm{m}^3$.

## Model

Strata absorb the intercept (`0 +` on the RHS). Bare pre-built term objects
are not formula-safe (they become `linear()`), so `mgp()` is written inline;
`psd_prior(term = mgp(...), ...)` repeats the same call. Keep a copy of the
term for later `psd()` plots.

```{r model-spec}
pm10_mgp <- mgp(
  "pm10",
  a = 2,
  c = 0,
  k = 30,
  region = c(8, 100),
  ref_value = "left"
)

cc_mgp <- dirichlet_multinom(
  all,
  by = c("year", "month", "dow"),
  init = 0.02
) ~ 0 + rh +
  mgp(pm10, a = 2, c = 0, k = 30, region = c(8, 100), ref_value = "left") +
  iwp(tmean, p = 3, knots = seq(-2, 30, by = 2), ref_value = 20, init = 0.001) +
  psd_prior(
    term = mgp(pm10, a = 2, c = 0, k = 30, region = c(8, 100), ref_value = "left"),
    u = 0.01, alpha = 0.5, h = 5, x = 8
  )
```

An IWP comparison uses a matched prior on the 5-unit predictive SD:

```{r model-iwp}
pm10_iwp <- iwp(
  "pm10",
  p = 2,
  knots = seq(8, 100, by = 4),
  ref_value = 8,
  init = 0.001
)
cc_iwp <- dirichlet_multinom(
  all,
  by = c("year", "month", "dow"),
  init = 0.02
) ~ 0 + rh +
  iwp(pm10, p = 2, knots = seq(8, 100, by = 4), ref_value = 8, init = 0.001) +
  iwp(tmean, p = 3, knots = seq(-2, 30, by = 2), ref_value = 20, init = 0.001) +
  psd_prior(
    term = iwp(pm10, p = 2, knots = seq(8, 100, by = 4), ref_value = 8, init = 0.001),
    u = 0.01, alpha = 0.5, h = 5
  )
```

## Fit

```{r fit}
fit_mgp <- adlaplace(
  formula = cc_mgp,
  data = london,
  config = list(
    num_threads = vignette_num_threads,
    num_shards = fit_num_shards
  ),
  control = list(maxit = fit_maxit, trace = 3, REPORT = 5),
  verbose = FALSE,
  hessian = vignette_full
)
fit_mgp$par_info
```

```{r fit-iwp}
fit_iwp <- adlaplace(
  formula = cc_iwp,
  data = london,
  config = list(
    num_threads = vignette_num_threads,
    num_shards = fit_num_shards
  ),
  control = list(maxit = fit_maxit, trace = 3, REPORT = 5),
  verbose = FALSE,
  hessian = vignette_full
)
```

## Relative risk vs PM10

```{r plot-rr}
num_sim <- if (vignette_full) 200L else 40L
num_grid <- 81L
set.seed(1)
sim_mgp <- sim_random(
  "pm10",
  fit = fit_mgp,
  num_sim = num_sim,
  num_grid = num_grid,
  transform = exp
)
set.seed(1)
sim_iwp <- sim_random(
  "pm10",
  fit = fit_iwp,
  num_sim = num_sim,
  num_grid = num_grid,
  transform = exp
)

oldpar <- par(no.readonly = TRUE)
par(mar = c(3, 3, 1, 1), bty = "l", mgp = c(1.8, 0.5, 0))
plot(
  sim_mgp$x, sim_mgp$pointwise[, "0.5"],
  type = "l", lwd = 2, col = "#1b4f72",
  xlab = expression(PM[10]), ylab = "RR",
  ylim = range(sim_mgp$pointwise, sim_iwp$pointwise)
)
matlines(sim_mgp$x, sim_mgp$pointwise[, c("0.1", "0.9")], lty = 2, col = "#1b4f72")
lines(sim_iwp$x, sim_iwp$pointwise[, "0.5"], lwd = 2, col = "#b03a2e")
matlines(sim_iwp$x, sim_iwp$pointwise[, c("0.1", "0.9")], lty = 2, col = "#b03a2e")
legend(
  "topleft",
  legend = c("mGP (a = 2)", "IWP (p = 2)"),
  col = c("#1b4f72", "#b03a2e"),
  lwd = 2,
  bty = "n"
)
par(oldpar)
```

## Sensitivity in $a$

```{r sensitivity, eval = vignette_full}
fit_a <- function(a) {
  fml <- dirichlet_multinom(all, by = c("year", "month", "dow"), init = 0.02) ~
    0 + rh +
    mgp(pm10, a = a, c = 0, k = 30, region = c(8, 100), ref_value = "left") +
    iwp(tmean, p = 3, knots = seq(-2, 30, by = 2), ref_value = 20, init = 0.001) +
    psd_prior(
      term = mgp(pm10, a = a, c = 0, k = 30, region = c(8, 100), ref_value = "left"),
      u = 0.01, alpha = 0.5, h = 5, x = 8
    )
  adlaplace(
    fml,
    data = london,
    config = list(num_threads = vignette_num_threads, num_shards = fit_num_shards),
    control = list(maxit = fit_maxit),
    verbose = FALSE,
    hessian = FALSE
  )
}
fits <- lapply(c(1, 2, Inf), fit_a)
logliks <- vapply(fits, function(f) as.numeric(stats::logLik(f)), numeric(1))
data.frame(a = c(1, 2, Inf), logLik = logliks)

fit_two <- adlaplace(
  dirichlet_multinom(all, by = c("year", "month", "dow"), init = 0.02) ~
    0 + rh +
    mgp(pm10, a = 2, c = 0, k = 30, region = c(8, 100), ref_value = 40) +
    iwp(tmean, p = 3, knots = seq(-2, 30, by = 2), ref_value = 20, init = 0.001) +
    psd_prior(
      term = mgp(pm10, a = 2, c = 0, k = 30, region = c(8, 100), ref_value = 40),
      u = 0.01, alpha = 0.5, h = 5, x = 40
    ),
  data = london,
  config = list(num_threads = vignette_num_threads, num_shards = fit_num_shards),
  control = list(maxit = fit_maxit),
  verbose = FALSE,
  hessian = FALSE
)
as.numeric(stats::logLik(fit_two))
```

## Prior vs posterior predictive SD

```{r psd-plots}
sd_col <- if ("mle" %in% names(fit_mgp$par_info)) "mle" else "init"
sd_mgp <- fit_mgp$par_info[[sd_col]][fit_mgp$par_info$label == "pm10_mgp"]
sd_iwp <- fit_iwp$par_info[[sd_col]][fit_iwp$par_info$label == "pm10_iwp"]

h <- 5
x_grid <- seq(8, 90, length.out = 40)
psd_mgp_x <- psd(pm10_mgp$pm10_mgp, h = h, x = x_grid, sd = sd_mgp)
psd_iwp_x <- rep(psd(pm10_iwp$pm10_iwp, h = h, sd = sd_iwp), length(x_grid))

oldpar <- par(no.readonly = TRUE)
par(mfrow = c(1, 2), mar = c(3, 3, 1.5, 1), bty = "l", mgp = c(1.8, 0.5, 0))
plot(
  x_grid, psd_mgp_x,
  type = "l", lwd = 2, col = "#1b4f72",
  xlab = expression(PM[10]), ylab = expression(sigma[x](5)),
  main = "PSD vs x",
  ylim = range(psd_mgp_x, psd_iwp_x)
)
lines(x_grid, psd_iwp_x, lwd = 2, col = "#b03a2e")
legend("topleft", c("mGP", "IWP"), col = c("#1b4f72", "#b03a2e"), lwd = 2, bty = "n")

# Prior vs posterior on the PSD scale at x = 8
rate_mgp <- psd_prior(pm10_mgp, u = 0.01, alpha = 0.5, h = 5, x = 8)@rate
rate_iwp <- psd_prior(pm10_iwp, u = 0.01, alpha = 0.5, h = 5)@rate
s <- seq(1e-4, 0.05, length.out = 200)
plot(
  s, dexp(s, rate = rate_mgp),
  type = "l", lwd = 2, col = "#1b4f72",
  xlab = expression(sigma[8](5)), ylab = "density",
  main = "Prior density of PSD"
)
lines(s, dexp(s, rate = rate_iwp), lwd = 2, col = "#b03a2e")
abline(v = psd(pm10_mgp$pm10_mgp, h = 5, x = 8, sd = sd_mgp), col = "#1b4f72", lty = 2)
abline(v = psd(pm10_iwp$pm10_iwp, h = 5, sd = sd_iwp), col = "#b03a2e", lty = 2)
legend("topright", c("mGP prior", "IWP prior", "posterior PSD"), lty = c(1, 1, 2), bty = "n")
par(oldpar)
```

The left panel shows that the mGP predictive SD depends on $x$ (nonstationary),
while the IWP predictive SD is constant.
